author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A hacker accessed data from 1.2 million French bank accounts using stolen official credentials, the Economy Ministry said. title: French Ministry confirms data access to 1.2 Million bank accounts

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Notepad++ patched a vulnerability that attackers used to hijack its update system and deliver malware to targeted users. Notepad++ fixed a vulnerability that allowed a China-linked APT group to hijack its update mechanism and selectively push malware to chosen targets. In early February, the Notepad++ maintainer revealed that nation-state hackers compromised the hosting provider’s infrastructure, […]
title: Notepad++ patches flaw used to hijack update system

title: China-linked APT weaponized Dell RecoverPoint zero-day since 2024
